dct_description_sm: THIS IS A GEOREFERENCED FILE. The Sooke, Metchosin, Esquimalt, Victoria, Lake, South Saanich, and North Saanich Districts of southern Vancouver Island divided up into plots of land. The Highland District is also included but does not have any plots of land on it, only relief shading. Some of the plots have numbers and letters labeling them, some are labeled as government reserves, and some are highlighted in different colours (there is no legend or references to what either the labels or colours mean). There are relief shading and markings to show the land forms. Some features are named including the Sooke Harbour, Parry Bay, Royal Harbour, Finlayson Inlet, Equimalt Harbour, Victoria Harbour, and Elk Lake.
